title: perf: optimize relay eth_fillTransaction
body:
Restructure the eth_fillTransaction handler to maximize concurrency:

- Path A (guaranteed sponsorship): skip fee token resolution, single fill, then parallelize simulate/sign/autoSwap metadata
- Path B (conditional sponsorship): fire sponsored and unsponsored fills in parallel, validate, pick the right one, then parallelize simulate/sign/autoSwap metadata
- Path C (no sponsorship): resolve fee token, single fill, parallelize simulate/autoSwap metadata
- Short-circuit prepared transactions (already have gas/nonce/ maxFeePerGas) to skip the fill RPC entirely
- Skip Sponsorship.sign when feePayerSignature is already present
